title: Resonance
author: pmays123
rules:
Resonance, by pmays123

• Place the digits 1-6 once in each row and column.

• Regions: The red lines show the grid divided into six regions, and the thicker blue lines show the grid divided into five regions. Blue lines don't further divide red regions, and red lines don't further divide blue regions.

• Region Sums: Clues inside the grid refer to the region of matching color they sit in and equal the sum of all digits fully or partially in its region, where cells cut in half by its border contribute half their digit to the sum. For example, if r2c5 is 5 then that cell contributes 2.5 for the "??.A" clue and 5 for the "?D.A" clue.

• Grid Sums: The outside clues each equal the sum of all digits in the grid, but cells cut in half by a region border of the same color as the clue only contribute half their digit to that clue's grid sum. Cells cut by a region border of a different color (or not cut at all) contribute their full digit.

• Cipher: All clues are decimal numbers, but letters and question marks stand in for some of their digits. The same letter always represents the same digit, and different letters always represent different digits. Question marks represent any digit from 0-9 wherever they appear (not necessarily always the same digit, and they may be the same digit as a letter). For example, a "??A.B" clue may be 122.3 or 008.5 but not 146.6.

Link to Puzzle: Sudokupad

I hope you enjoy solving and have a lovely day! :)
solutionCode: Row 2 (left to right) followed by the values for ABCD (10 digits total)
